title: India's richest man now wants to turn aging computers into AI-ready PCs | TechCrunch
summary: Mukesh Ambani’s Reliance Jio is opening its cloud PC service to any internet user in India, positioning it as a way to turn aging computers into AI-ready machines without hardware upgrades.
